segments.name: Medical devices
segments.description: Develops and sells or leases Deep TMS systems for treating psychiatric disorders such as MDD, OCD and smoking addiction for clinicians and patients.
segments.evidence: If our employees or our independent distributors and agents fail to adequately promote, market and sell or lease our Deep TMS systems, our revenues could significantly decrease and/or fail to meet our targets.

revenueModel.text: The company earns revenue by selling or leasing Deep TMS systems to healthcare providers, relying on third-party payor reimbursement and, in some cases, cash-pay models.
revenueModel.evidence: Even if a third-party payor covers a particular treatment that uses Deep TMS, the resulting reimbursement rate may not be adequate to cover a provider's cost to purchase or lease the Deep TMS system or ensure such transaction is profitable for the provider.
